Glossary

Place Names & Cycling Vocabulary

The Chinese place names and a few recurring words from the trip, with pinyin for pronunciation.

Places along the route

The nine stops on the Huandao route
Chinese Pinyin English
台北 táiběi Taipei
新竹 xīnzhú Hsinchu
台中 táizhōng Taichung
嘉義 jiāyì Chiayi
高雄 gāoxióng Kaohsiung

Words to know

Cycling and trip vocabulary
Chinese Pinyin Meaning
環島 huándǎo Ride around Taiwan
地瓜 dìguā Sweet potato — Taiwan's shape-based nickname; finishing the Huandao is jokingly called “riding the whole sweet potato”
番薯 fānshǔ Sweet potato — the Taiwanese/Hoklo term for the same nickname, tied to local identity
寶島 bǎodǎo “Treasure Island” — a common affectionate nickname for Taiwan
福爾摩沙 fú'ěrmóshā Formosa — the historical “beautiful island” name for Taiwan
捷安特 jiéāntè Giant, the bicycle company that ran the tour
腳踏車 jiǎotàchē Bicycle
鐵馬 tiěmǎ “Iron horse” — an old, still-common slang term for bicycle
電輔車 diànfǔchē E-bike (electric-assist bicycle)
單車旅行 dānchē lǚxíng Bike touring
自行車道 zìxíngchē dào Bike path
河濱自行車道 hébīn zìxíngchē dào Riverside bike path
補給 bǔjǐ Food and drink stop
補水 bǔshuǐ Refill water
補胎 bǔtāi Repair a flat tire
爆胎 bàotāi Flat tire
打氣 dǎqì Inflate a tire
打卡 dǎkǎ Check in at a scenic spot
上坡 shàngpō Climb
爬坡 pápō Climbing a hill
長坡 chángpō Long climb
陡坡 dǒupō Steep climb
下坡 xiàpō Descent
順風 shùnfēng Tailwind
逆風 nìfēng Headwind
側風 cèfēng Crosswind
配速 pèisù Pace
放慢速度 fàngmàn sùdù Slow down
輕鬆騎 qīngsōng qí Easy ride
巡航速度 xúnháng sùdù Cruising speed
休息一下 xiūxi yíxià Take a break
騎多遠？ qí duō yuǎn? How far are you riding?
還有幾公里？ hái yǒu jǐ gōnglǐ? How many kilometers left?
今天騎到哪裡？ jīntiān qí dào nǎlǐ? Where are you riding today?
今天住哪裡？ jīntiān zhù nǎlǐ? Where are you staying tonight?
民宿 mínsù Guesthouse
青年旅館 qīngnián lǚguǎn Hostel
單車友善 dānchē yǒushàn Bike friendly
單車停放區 dānchē tíngfàng qū Bicycle parking
超商 chāoshāng Convenience store
超商補給 chāoshāng bǔjǐ Convenience store snack stop
車店 chēdiàn Bike shop
車友 chēyǒu Fellow cyclist
車隊 chēduì Cycling group
揪團 jiūtuán Organize a group ride
一起騎 yìqǐ qí Ride together
安全第一 ānquán dìyī Safety first
慢慢騎 mànmàn qí Ride easy
順順騎 shùnshùn qí Ride smoothly
一路平安 yílù píng'ān Have a safe ride
加油！ jiāyóu! Keep going! You've got this!
辛苦了！ xīnkǔ le! Nice work! Thanks for the effort!
廟 miào Temple — Taoist or Confucian, a common rest stop
溫泉 wēnquán Hot spring
好天氣 hǎo tiānqì Great riding weather
下雨 xià yǔ Raining
雨衣 yǔyī Rain jacket
看海 kàn hǎi Enjoy the ocean view
看日出 kàn rìchū Watch the sunrise
看日落 kàn rìluò Watch the sunset

Cyclist sayings

Phrases you'll actually hear on a group ride in Taiwan.

Common sayings among touring cyclists in Taiwan
Chinese Pinyin Meaning
騎完整顆地瓜 qí wán zhěng kē dìguā Rode the whole sweet potato — finished the full Huandao loop.
今天佛系騎 jīntiān fóxì qí Today we're taking it easy.
今天咖啡騎 jīntiān kāfēi qí Casual ride with lots of café stops.
今天吃貨騎 jīntiān chīhuò qí Ride centered around great food.
有坡就有風景 yǒu pō jiù yǒu fēngjǐng Every climb comes with a view.
山頂見 shāndǐng jiàn See you at the summit.
先補給再說 xiān bǔjǐ zài shuō Food first, everything else later.
7-11集合 qī-shíyī jíhé Meet at the 7-Eleven — a classic Taiwan cycling phrase.
全家補水 quánjiā bǔshuǐ Refill water at FamilyMart.
慢慢騎比較快 mànmàn qí bǐjiào kuài Ride steadily, you'll get there sooner.
今天逆風 jīntiān nìfēng Today is all headwind.
下坡爽 xiàpō shuǎng Descending feels amazing.
不趕時間 bù gǎn shíjiān No rush today.
騎得開心最重要 qí de kāixīn zuì zhòngyào Having fun is what matters.
今天收工 jīntiān shōugōng We're done riding for today.
明天繼續 míngtiān jìxù We'll keep riding tomorrow.
